title: Cinema on Saturday
intro: Deniz ile Emma'nın sinema planı yaptığı mesajlaşmayı okuyacaksın.
text:
Deniz: Hi Emma! What are you doing on Saturday?
Emma: Nothing special. I am at home. Why?
Deniz: There is a new film at the Star Cinema. It is a comedy.
Emma: Nice! What time does it start?
Deniz: At seven o'clock. But the tickets are cheap before six.
Emma: OK, can we meet early? I finish work at five.
Deniz: Sure. Let's meet at half past five in front of the cinema.
Emma: Perfect. Is Murat coming too?
Deniz: No, he is busy. He has got an exam on Monday.
Emma: Poor Murat! I have got twenty lira. Is that enough for a ticket?
Deniz: Yes, a ticket is fifteen lira. See you on Saturday!
Emma: See you!

questions.text: What time does the film start?
questions.explain: Deniz "At seven o'clock." diyor. Beş buçuk filmin saati değil, buluşma saatidir.

questions.text: Murat is going to the cinema with them.
questions.explain: Deniz "No, he is busy. He has got an exam on Monday." diyor, yani Murat gelmiyor.

questions.text: Where do Deniz and Emma meet?
questions.explain: Deniz "Let's meet at half past five in front of the cinema." diyor. Buluşma yeri sinemanın önü.

questions.text: How much is one ticket?
questions.explain: Deniz "a ticket is fifteen lira" diyor. Yirmi lira Emma'nın cebindeki para.

title: Elena's Profile
intro: Bir dil değişim sitesindeki kendini tanıtma profilini okuyacaksın.
text:
LANGUAGE FRIENDS — Member Profile

Name: Elena Rossi
Age: 27
City: Milan, Italy
Job: nurse in a small hospital

About me:
Hello! I am Elena. I am 27 years old and I live in Milan with my sister. I work as a nurse. I start work at seven in the morning, so I am always tired at night!

I speak Italian and Spanish. Now I am learning English because I want to work in London. I have got a cat, and I love old films and long walks.

I am free on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. There is a nice café near my flat. We can talk there, or we can talk online. Please write me a message!

questions.text: How old is Elena?
questions.explain: Profilde "Age: 27" yazıyor ve metinde "I am 27 years old" diyor.

questions.text: Elena lives alone in Milan.
questions.explain: Yanlış. Metinde "I live in Milan with my sister" diyor, yani kız kardeşiyle yaşıyor.

questions.text: What time does Elena start work?
questions.explain: "I start work at seven in the morning" cümlesi işe saat yedide başladığını söylüyor.

questions.text: Why is Elena learning English?
options: She wants to work in London
She wants to study in Milan
questions.explain: "I am learning English because I want to work in London" diyor; amacı Londra'da çalışmak.

title: Our Family Photo
intro: Elif'in arkadaşına gönderdiği, aile fotoğrafını anlatan e-postayı okuyacaksın.
text:
From: Elif
To: Anna
Subject: Our family photo

Hi Anna,

Here is the photo from my birthday. It is our new family photo.

My mother is in the middle. She is wearing a red dress. Her name is Ayse. My father is next to her. He is tall and he has got grey hair.

I am on the left with my brother Kerem. He is nine years old. He is holding our cat, Pamuk.

There are two women behind us. They are my aunts. My aunt Zeynep is a nurse. She is laughing in the photo!

My grandmother is not in the photo. She is taking the photo.

Write soon,
Elif

questions.text: Who is in the middle of the photo?
questions.explain: Metinde "My mother is in the middle." yazıyor. Yani ortadaki kişi Elif'in annesi.

questions.text: What is aunt Zeynep's job?
questions.explain: E-postada "My aunt Zeynep is a nurse." diyor. Zeynep hemşire.

questions.text: Kerem is ten years old.
questions.explain: Yanlış. Metinde Kerem için "He is nine years old." yazıyor, yani dokuz yaşında.

questions.text: Why is Elif's grandmother not in the photo?
questions.explain: Son satırda "She is taking the photo." diyor. Büyükanne fotoğrafı çektiği için karede yok.

title: My Tuesday
intro: Bir öğrencinin salı gününü saat saat anlattığı günlük yazısını okuyacaksın.
text:
Tuesday, 14 March

I get up at half past six. I am always tired, but I open the window and drink a big glass of water.
At seven o'clock I have breakfast with my sister Elif. She makes tea.
I walk to school. It is twenty minutes.
Lessons start at eight. My favourite lesson is science, because our teacher is funny.
At half past twelve we have lunch. Today it is rice and a small salad.
After school I go to the library with Deniz. We do our homework there until five.
In the evening I help my mother in the kitchen. Then I watch one film.
I go to bed at eleven. Tomorrow is Wednesday and I have got a maths exam!

questions.text: What time does the writer get up?
questions.explain: Metnin ilk cümlesi "I get up at half past six" diyor. Saat yedi kahvaltı saati.

questions.text: The writer goes to school by bus.
questions.explain: Yanlış. Metinde "I walk to school. It is twenty minutes." yazıyor, yani yürüyor.

questions.text: Who does the writer do homework with after school?
questions.explain: "After school I go to the library with Deniz. We do our homework there until five." Elif kahvaltıdaki kız kardeşi.

questions.text: What has the writer got tomorrow?
questions.explain: Son cümle: "Tomorrow is Wednesday and I have got a maths exam!"

title: Note on the Fridge
intro: Ev arkadaşın Dan'in buzdolabına bıraktığı ev işleri notunu okuyacaksın.
text:
Hi Ela,

I am at work until six o'clock. Sorry, the flat is a little messy! Can you help me today, please?

1. The kitchen bin is full. Please take it out.
2. There is no milk and no bread. Can you go to the small shop on Green Street? It closes at seven.
3. My brother Tom is coming at eight. He is sleeping here tonight. There are clean sheets in the big cupboard.

I am cooking pasta for dinner. You don't need to cook!

The washing machine is on now. Please don't open it.

Money for the shop is on the table — twenty pounds.

Thanks a lot!
Dan

questions.text: What time is Dan at work until?
questions.explain: Not'un başında "I am at work until six o'clock" yazıyor. Yedi dükkânın kapanma saati, sekiz de Tom'un geliş saati.

questions.text: Ela must cook dinner tonight.
questions.explain: Dan "I am cooking pasta for dinner. You don't need to cook!" diyor. Yemeği Dan yapıyor.

questions.text: Who is coming at eight o'clock?
questions.explain: Notta "My brother Tom is coming at eight" yazıyor. Gelen kişi Dan'in kardeşi Tom.

questions.text: How much money is on the table?
questions.explain: Son satırda "Money for the shop is on the table — twenty pounds" deniyor. Masada yirmi pound var.

title: Postcard from Antalya
intro: Deniz'in tatilden arkadaşı Elif'e gönderdiği kartpostalı okuyacaksın.
text:
Hi Elif!

Greetings from Antalya! We arrived on Friday evening. The hotel is small but very nice. Our room has got a big balcony.

On Saturday we were at the beach all day. The water was warm and my brother swam for two hours. In the afternoon we ate fish at a small restaurant near the harbour. It cost only 200 lira!

On Sunday morning I visited the old town with Dad. We walked for three hours and I took forty photos. Mum stayed at the hotel because she was tired.

Now I am sitting on the balcony. The sun is going down and the sea is orange. I am writing this postcard for you.

See you next week!
Deniz

questions.text: When did Deniz's family arrive in Antalya?
questions.explain: Metinde "We arrived on Friday evening" yazıyor, yani cuma akşamı vardılar. Cumartesi plaja gittiler, ama varış günü değil.

questions.text: Deniz's brother swam for two hours.
questions.explain: Metinde "my brother swam for two hours" diyor. Yani doğru.

questions.text: How many photos did Deniz take in the old town?
questions.explain: "I took forty photos" cümlesine göre kırk fotoğraf çekti. Üç saat yürüdükleri de aynı cümlede yazıyor.

questions.text: Why did Mum stay at the hotel on Sunday?
questions.explain: Metinde "Mum stayed at the hotel because she was tired" yazıyor. Kartpostalı yazan kişi ise Deniz.
